files.README.md:
# Tessellate

Polygon triangulation for the web: ear clipping, holes, and an indexed buffer ready for WebGL.

![CI](https://img.shields.io/badge/ci-passing-brightgreen.svg)

![A floor plan, triangulated](docs/floor-plan.png)

![The ear-clipping walk](https://tessellate.dev/media/ears.gif)

## Install

```sh
npm install tessellate
```

See the [guide](https://tessellate.dev/guide) for more.

name: triangulate
description: Triangulate a polygon with Tessellate and check the result covers it.
---

# Triangulate

Call `triangulate(points)` with the outline's points in order; it answers triples of indices.
